runtime_uncertainties: The law supplies no numeric "as close as practicable" cutoff; positions are measured without legal interpretation.
Actual connected two-directional approach and one-way departure map geometry, full body containment and camera visibility remain unverified.
No exact construction, four-camera capture, source-bound finalizer or saved-processing proof exists yet.
law_text: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a left turn from a two-directional highway onto a one-way highway, the approach for the left turn must be made in that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof, and the turn must be made by turning from the right of the centerline where it enters the intersection as close as practicable to the left-hand curb of the one-way highway.

alternatives_and_boundaries: Two-directional approach highway to one-way departure highway and left-turn intention are fixed activation facts.
Compare measured approach full-body lateral position within the right half nearest the centerline while keeping departure path fixed.
Compare departure full-body position near the left-hand curb while keeping approach fixed. No lawful lateral cutoff is supplied.
